linked_observations.observation: Travel history and antibiotic non-response were used to support infectious colitis while maintaining IBD prominence, showing coherent evidence-sensitive updating.

d5c.evidence_quote: How long have you had these symptoms in total, and have you noticed any unintentional weight loss? Also, if you have had a colonoscopy or a blood test (such as a full blood count or CRP) done recently, could I review those results?
d5c.reason: All three essential requirements were actively requested at appropriate times: course/severity (turns 1, 4, 5), exposure and antibiotic history (turn 6, fulfilled), and existing investigation results (turns 3–4, with the later request appropriately specifying colonoscopy, FBC and CRP). Minor weaknesses include two initially broad test requests that failed to release results and no enquiry about prior skin lesions, but these do not materially compromise the assessment.

requirement_checks.request_quote: How long have you had the diarrhoea and blood in your stool, and have you noticed any associated symptoms such as fever, abdominal pain, weight loss, or urgency to pass stool?
requirement_checks.reason: Duration and associated severity features were repeatedly requested and urgency/cramps were returned, though exact duration remained unavailable.

requirement_checks.request_quote: Have you had any recent travel, or taken antibiotics in the past few weeks?
requirement_checks.reason: Travel and antibiotic response history was requested and both facts were returned.

requirement_checks.request_quote: if you have had a colonoscopy or a blood test (such as a full blood count or CRP) done recently, could I review those results?
requirement_checks.reason: A specific, adequate request for existing inflammatory/infective investigation evidence was made but the environment returned no results.

requirement_checks.request_quote: Can you tell me more about the morning back stiffness—how long does it last, does it improve with movement or exercise...
requirement_checks.reason: Musculoskeletal extraintestinal history was probed but prior skin lesions were never asked about and no extraintestinal detail was returned.
